Housing & Dining

Housing & Dining
Housing
On-Campus Housing
International students can select from the 31 campus residence halls. Double occupancy rooms are the only option. Apartment style housing is limited.
If you apply for on-campus housing you will receive an assigned move in day and time.
Housing at UNC
Off-Campus Housing
International students can reside in off–campus housing. Students who choose to live off-campus are responsible for finding their own housing.
The below resource is being provided on an informational basis only. The University has not vetted and has no affiliation with any of the third party sites.

Dining
Students are not required to purchase a meal plan at UNC-Chapel Hill, but it is strongly recommended. Learn more about on-campus dining, off-campus dining, and meal plans.
